title: The Air that Loved to Climb
intro: This quiz follows Ava and Liam as they discover why warm air rises and cool air sinks.

questions.prompt: What did Ava notice floating above the trees?
questions.explanation: Ava noticed a hot air balloon floating above the trees.

questions.prompt: What happens to air particles when the air becomes warmer?
choices: They move slower and closer together
They move faster and spread farther apart
questions.explanation: When air becomes warmer, its particles move faster and spread farther apart.
Cool air is more dense, so it sinks.

questions.prompt: What happens when warm air rises?
choices: Cooler air moves in to take its place
questions.explanation: When warm air rises, cooler air moves in to take its place.

questions.prompt: Why did the hot air balloon rise?
choices: The air inside was warmer and lighter than the cooler air outside
The balloon was filled with cool water
questions.explanation: The balloon rose because the air inside was warmer and lighter than the cooler air outside.
